Reading Comprehension — الجزء الأول

I live in a big town. This is my school. I go to school by bus. There is a library next to my school. We borrow books from the library.

صفحة 23Reading Comprehensionتكملة القطعة

الجزء الثانى

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

There is a bakery next to our house. It bakes tasty bread. The supermarket is next to the bank. Mum goes to the bank to get money. We go shopping every weekend. We sometimes go to the park to play or to the cinema to watch films. There is a big hospital in my town. The doctors in the hospital are kind.

John يتجوّل فى مدينته

صفحة 27Writingالكتابة

1 — Punctuate the following sentences.

9 a — do you like to eat pizza
Do you like to eat pizza?
10 b — what is your favourite colour
What is your favourite colour?
11 c — what time do you go to bed
What time do you go to bed?
12 d — how old are you
How old are you?

2 — Answer the following questions.

13 a — How do you go to school?
I go to school by bus / by car / on foot.
14 b — What do you buy when you go shopping?
I buy food and fruit.
15 c — Do you like to go to the cinema?
Yes, I do. / No, I don’t.
16 d — What do you buy at the bakery?
I buy bread from the bakery.

I live in a big town. This is my school. I go to school by bus. There is a library next to my school. We borrow books from the library. There is a bakery next to our house. It bakes tasty bread. The supermarket is next to the bank. Mum goes to the bank to get money. We go shopping every weekend. We sometimes go to the park to play or to the cinema to watch films. There is a big hospital in my town. The doctors in the hospital are kind.
